entities.summary: The Church of St. Louis of the French is a Catholic church near Piazza Navona in Rome. The church is dedicated to the patron saints of France: Virgin Mary, Denis of Paris, and King Louis IX of France. San Luigi dei Francesi is a church building in Europe, established in 1518. A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
